body.heading: Short title and date of operation
body.raw_text: 1. (1) This Act may be cited as the Registration of Documents (Amendment) Act, No. 18 of 2024. (2) The provisions of this Act, other than the provisions of this section, shall come into operation on such date as the Minister may appoint by Order published in the Gazette (in this Act referred to as the “appointed date”). (3) The provisions of this section shall come into operation on the date on which the Bill becomes an Act of Parliament.

body.heading: Amendment of section 8 of Chapter 117
body.raw_text: 2. Section 8 of the Registration of Documents Ordinance (Chapter 117) (in this Act referred to as the “principal enactment”) is hereby amended in the proviso to paragraph (b) of that section, by the addition immediately after subparagraph (xi) of that proviso, of the following new subparagraph: - “(xii) any agreement in relation to a transaction which is subject to the provisions of the Secured Transactions Act, No. 17 of 2024.”.

quality_notes: Parsed from the Government Printer PDF's own text layer, not from OCR. Every word of the source is accounted for in the tree (0.00% unmatched by scripts/check_parse_coverage.py). All ten sections are present and correctly numbered.
Build this tree from PowerShell, not Git Bash. Git Bash resolves pdftotext to an Xpdf 4.00 build that ignores '-enc UTF-8' and loses every curly quote and em dash to U+FFFD.

Corrected by hand on 2026-09-05 against pdftotext -layout of the PDF: marginal notes of ss.4, 7, 8, 9, 10 restored (they had absorbed body text or a page number); page headers 'Registration of Documents (Amendment) N' removed from ss.4, 8, 10; s.7's text completed (its second half had been read into the note); s.8's text restored to the printed order (the parser had interleaved the two quoted phrases); s.9 rebuilt as subsections (1)-(3) with paragraphs (a), (b)(i)-(ii) and the closing words, and s.9(2)-(3) restored where the parser had dropped 'Act, No. 17 of 2024, be deemed to have been perfected from' and 'is not' / 'Act, No. 17 of 2024 prior to the expiration of two years from the'. Parser readings kept in heading_raw / raw_text_parser / text_raw_parser.

Instructions filled for every section: s.2 insert 8(b) proviso (xii); s.3 repeal Chapter IV (ss.16-24); s.4 substitute Chapter V heading; s.5 words in s.25; s.6 words in 29(1) and the s.29 marginal note; s.7 words in s.41; s.8 words in First Schedule Part III item 2; s.9 transitional.
commencement_note: s.1(2): the provisions other than s.1 come into operation on a date the Minister appoints by Order in the Gazette (the 'appointed date'); s.1(3): s.1 on the date the Bill becomes an Act. No held source shows the appointing Order.
